line_count_note: 57 typed text baselines, counting the parallel date as its own line; the separate dash row, autograph and marginal numeral are inventoried separately.
layout: A typed university thesis-defense notice on a single 1673 × 2354 sheet. A centered letterhead block occupies the upper left and the date the upper right. Two underlined headings precede labeled candidate, title, defense, directors and laboratory fields. Seven abstract paragraphs fill the middle. The lower part gives duration, a six-member jury, a three-line closing role, an overlapping signature and the printed name. A light handwritten 13 lies at lower left. The source has twelve separate keyed dashes beneath the letterhead and three physical line-end hyphens in the abstract. No manuscript page number is present at the top.
legibility: Most typewriting is sharp enough to read letter by letter, including capitals, accents, abbreviations and points. A horizontal fold crosses the third abstract paragraph without hiding its wording. The single exposed bar above the i in the candidate’s given name does not expose separate diaeresis dots, so its reading remains local and explicit. The three Latin species names are clearly legible in italic forms; the scan alone does not establish whether those forms were produced mechanically or by hand. The autograph has clear broad contours but no secure alphabetic sequence; it is reproduced graphically across the printed closing lines. The marginal 13 is lighter but readable. The whole source, both supplied halves and six saved first-reading crops were inspected.
witness_comparison: Only witness C is supplied; witness H is absent, and every differs_H flag is false. C agrees with the typed body wording, including the unusual printed name KAUMAN, the unpointed final A in NABLI M.A, 3ème on the heading baseline, the recorded times and dates, and the scientific terms. C substitutes a continuous underline for the separate twelve-dash row and gives a diaeresis where the scan exposes a horizontal bar. Its proposed alphabetic signature is left undecided and replaced by source-contour reproduction alongside the independently readable printed name. The three source line-end hyphens are restored as layout evidence, outside the lexical error count. No external biographical, botanical or historical information was used to change the notice.

notes: This is a thesis-defense notice rather than a mathematical note. It is dated Montpellier, 20 octobre 1983 (upper-right date block) and names the candidate on line 11 with the local i-diacritic doubt preserved. Lines 12–18 give the thesis title about seasonal secondary tissues of three Mediterranean tree species, the planned defense on 28 Octobre 1983 at 9h30 in Salle de Cours n°9, the directors and the Laboratoire de Biologie Végétale. The seven abstract paragraphs (lines 20–45) describe anatomical, histological and histochemical observations of Olea europaea, Quercus ilex and Celtis australis; the notice reports seasonal cambial activity, conducting tissues, starch reserves, callose and metabolic activity. Lines 46–53 state a three-year research duration and list the proposed jury exactly as typed. Lines 54–57 give the administrative closing role and printed A. GENTIL. The overlapping autograph remains alphabetically undecided. This account records the notice’s contents and does not verify its botanical or administrative claims. Physical split hyphens are preserved as layout evidence without lexical error counts. No mathematical check was performed.

deletion_insertion_check: No canceled or inserted prose is exposed on this notice. The long autograph strokes cross printed Universitaire and GENTIL; their continuity into the signature contours is preserved rather than classifying the printed letters as canceled. The detached short left stroke is included in the autograph drawing, as are the upper sweep, oval and separate lower flourish. The letterhead’s twelve dashes remain a separate keyed row. Three printed line-end hyphens are retained at their physical splits, without treating them as lexical corrections. The italic species names remain italic with no asserted production method. The light lower-left 13 remains a margin entry; there is no added top manuscript number. An editorial uncertainty marker stands beside the signature; it is not represented as source ink.
root_adjudication: Root viewed the whole source and all six saved crops. The separate twelve-dash row, bar/diaeresis uncertainty in Saïda, three physical line-end hyphens, italic species names with production method unassigned, signature contour overlap and lower-left 13 were checked and accepted. A visible uncertainty node was required beside the autograph and is now synchronized in the figure and decision records. Printed A. GENTIL does not settle the autograph alphabetically. No botanical claim was independently checked.
